module: List of points along a path (rally driveline). Each point is a table {pos (vec3), quat, ts, normal, prev, next, id, partition, pacenoteDistances, cachedPacenotes{cs, ce, at, auto_at, half}}. The class can chain points (prev/next/id), compute their normals (snaproad/normals), measure the length, find the closest point and draw a debug preview. The module returns a constructor: require(...)(points).
notes: BUG: in createPoint, the parameter is named 'quat' and shadows the global function quat(); the default value 'quat or quat(0,0,0,1)' therefore calls nil if the argument is omitted (Lua error). Always pass a quaternion.
setAll replaces the points then recomputes relations (prev/next/id) and normals; the constructor does not.
The length is the sum of the 3D distances between consecutive points, in meters.

C.desc: List of points returned by the constructor; attribute self.points.

init.desc: Stores the provided list of points (empty by default) without computing relations or normals.

createPoint.desc: Creates a point in standard format (normal (0,0,1), empty pacenoteDistances, empty cachedPacenotes). Does not add the point to the list.

quat.desc: Orientation (see the bug in notes: do not omit it).

setupPointRelationships.desc: Fills in id (index), prev and next of each point.

setupPointNormals.desc: Computes each point's normal with snaproadNormals.forwardNormalVec and creates pacenoteDistances/cachedPacenotes if missing.

calculateLength.desc: Total length of the path (0 if fewer than 2 points).

getAll.desc: Internal table of all the points (not a copy).

setAll.desc: Replaces all the points then recomputes relations and normals.

findNearestPoint.desc: Closest point to a position (3D distance, linear scan).

returns.desc: Closest point, nil if the list is empty.

downsample.desc: Compatibility stub with DrivelineRoute: returns the list itself (drivelineV3 already simplifies).

drawDebug.desc: Draws a sphere per point (color recce_driveline_clr, alpha 0.3) and, if requested, the ts timestamp as a label. Call every frame.

drawLabels.desc: true to show the ts labels.
